headline: STOCK BAN
dek: House leaders teed up Rep. Bryan Steil’s Stop Insider Trading Act (H.R. 11142) for a floor vote, Bloomberg Government reports.

items.title: BANS BUYING STOCKS
items.text: Lawmakers, their spouses and dependent children couldn’t buy stock in public companies (Bloomberg Government).

items.title: SELLING ALLOWED
items.text: Members could sell with 7–14 days’ notice (Punchbowl News).

items.title: FORCE A SELL-OFF
items.text: No requirement to divest current holdings. Democrats have called for a wider ban that does (Bloomberg Government).

items.title: COVER THE PRESIDENT
items.text: Some Democrats want the ban to cover the president (Bloomberg Government).

steps.text: House passes the ban in a bill that also required photo voter ID
That version fails a Senate procedural vote
Rules Committee meets at 4 p.m. on the stand-alone bill

means.label: Split off:
means.text: This time the ban isn’t tied to voter ID, which Democrats largely rejected.

means.label: Democrats’ view:
means.text: They want a wider ban that requires divestment, and say they’ll prioritize a ban when they take control next year.

means.label: Next:
means.text: The House Rules Committee takes it up Nov. 30.

sources: Sources: Bloomberg Government, Nov. 25, 2026; House Rules Committee; Punchbowl News.
